android.desc: Are you looking for new fun trivia games, such as film quiz games? Want guess film trivia games that you can also enjoy with friends and family? Test or prove your movie knowledge in the largest movie trivia game – the Movie Buff. Whether you are a movie fan, or you are trying to prove to friends and family that you are a movie master, Movie Buff is one of the best trivia movie games to play. 🎞️10 FILM QUIZ CATEGORIES Unlike most movie puzzle guess film name games, Movie Buff features the largest movies trivia categories. See them all below. - 4 movie quiz categories for WORLDWIDE movie fans: Hollywood movies, Hollywood TV Series, Animated, Documentaries and World Cinema. - 6 movie quiz categories for Indian movie fans: Bollywood, Tamil, Telugu, Kannada, Bengali, and Malayalam Movies. 🎦 2 GAME MODES Compared to most movie & pop culture trivia games, we offer multiple game modes for each category. Pick between: 1. Classic Mode - which has timer to complete for each category 2. Challenge Mode with friends - which is a real-time quiz multiplayer mode 🏆 MOVIE TRIVIA REWARDS Complete all the movie questions that have time limits for each category. After you complete all the questions in 1 category you get the Certified Moviegoer award. As you complete another category a new achievement will be unlocked.
